location: Antrim Road, Templepatrick, Co. Antrim, BT39 0AP
tagline: A historic, beautifully restored venue for community events, weddings, meetings & cultural functions.

facilities.name: Main Function Hall
facilities.description: Spacious hall featuring original polished timber flooring, high vaulted ceiling acoustics, adjustable dimmable ambient lighting, and integrated stage area.

facilities.name: Commercial Kitchen & Servery
facilities.description: Fully equipped modern kitchen with double stainless steel catering sinks, commercial warming ovens, hot water urns, prep tables, and hatch servery into the supper room.

facilities.name: Modern Audiovisual Suite
facilities.description: HD ceiling projector with automated drop-down screen, wireless lapel & handheld microphones, Bluetooth audio connectivity, and speech amplification.

facilities.name: Accessibility & Parking
facilities.description: Step-free ramped entrance, accessible toilet facilities, wide doorway access throughout, and on-site tarmac parking for 45 vehicles plus street parking.

rates.details: For registered charities, local youth groups, and non-profit community meetings.
Birthdays, anniversaries, family gatherings, and evening receptions (minimum 3 hours).
Includes full access to AV equipment, committee room, and kitchen facilities.

faqs.question: Can we bring our own caterers?
faqs.answer: Yes! Hirers are welcome to bring external caterers or prepare food on-site using our commercial kitchen.

faqs.question: Is alcohol permitted on the premises?
faqs.answer: Alcohol permissions are granted subject to prior lodge committee approval and appropriate temporary licensing where required.

faqs.question: How do we arrange a viewing before booking?
faqs.answer: You can fill out our online booking inquiry form or contact the Hall Convenor directly to schedule a viewing.
